concept_summary: A daily ritual designed to help people 'live a fuller life every day of the week' during the rapid changes Bashar anticipated for 2015-2016. Saturday uses your favourite word, sound and image instead of statements, and Sunday is done with eyes closed. The point is to give the physical mind 'permission' to embody worthiness, gratitude, abundance, support, freedom and passion as felt states rather than ideas.

Hence 'circumstances don't matter, only state of being matters': circumstances are neutral and carry no built-in meaning; the state of being (the belief-emotion-thought complex you hold) determines what you can perceive and therefore which version of reality you experience ('you cannot perceive what you are not the vibration of'). Changing circumstances while keeping the belief regenerates the same pattern; changing the definition re-forms the whole chain. Fear and excitement are the same energy read through misaligned versus aligned beliefs.
visual_structure: Standard rendering (fan and explainer diagrams, not an official handout): a left-to-right or top-down chain of four boxes Belief -> Emotion -> Thought -> Action, often with a fifth box Experience/Reality and a feedback arrow from Experience back to Belief ('confirmation'). A companion two-column contrast: 'Circumstances' (crossed out / neutral) versus 'State of Being' (the cause), with an arrow State of Being -> Perception -> Experience. The fear/excitement variant: one energy source splitting through two belief filters into 'Excitement' and 'Fear'.
notes: Model content is well attested; there is no single official diagram — layout is the conventional one.

name: Physical Mind / Higher Mind division of labour
session_title_and_date: Recurring model (The Formula 2015; The Triad Mind 2017; nine levels 2011; many sessions)
concept_summary: The higher mind (non-physical, seeing past/present/future simultaneously) is responsible for conceiving the path and its timing; the physical mind (brain-based personality) is responsible only for perceiving what is happening now and acting on it. Bashar's stock phrasing: the physical mind 'is not designed to know how' — it cannot see the whole route and gets anxious when it tries; the higher mind 'is the pilot / navigator' and the physical mind the 'passenger / co-pilot' that reads the instruments and takes the next step. The higher mind's communication reaches the body as excitement (and, when the physical mind resists, as fear); synchronicity is the higher mind arranging the sequence. Trust means letting the physical mind do its job (perceive, decide, act in the moment) and stop doing the higher mind's (planning outcomes, insisting on how). The template level and the heart mind sit between the two as translator.
visual_structure: No official figure found. Conventional rendering: two boxes — 'Higher Mind: conceives, sees the whole path, chooses timing (pilot)' above 'Physical Mind: perceives, acts on what is in front of it (passenger/navigator)' — joined by a downward arrow labelled 'excitement / synchronicity' and an upward arrow 'trust / action', with a 'Template level / heart' band between them. Can also be drawn as the top three and bottom three bands of the nine-levels stack.
notes: The exact pilot/navigator/passenger wording varies by session; the division of labour is consistent.

name: Frames-of-film / parallel-reality shifting model ('billions of times per second')
session_title_and_date: Recurring model (Parallel Realities 1997; The Parallelogram 2013; Parallel Reality Wheel 2020; You Are All Time Travelers 2018)
concept_summary: Every possible reality already exists, complete and unchanging, like still frames on a film strip. Nothing in any frame ever changes; what changes is which frame consciousness is focused on, and it shifts 'billions of times a second', creating the illusion of motion, time and continuity — as a projector does. You are therefore 'a different person every moment', and you never change the world you are in: you change your state of being and thereby shift to a version of Earth that already reflects the change. Manifestation is selection, not construction. The 2020 'splitting prism' extension: many parallel Earths are now overlapping and diverging like light through a prism, so holding a preferred state of being becomes the navigation device; the Parallel Reality Wheel and the Eye of the Needle are exercises built on this model.
visual_structure: Conventional rendering: a horizontal strip of identical rectangular frames (a film strip), each frame a slightly different static picture, with a dot or eye labelled 'consciousness' hopping from frame to frame and an arrow '~billions of shifts per second'; a second panel showing frames fanning out into parallel strips ('parallel realities') with the path chosen by 'state of being'. The prism variant: a single beam entering a prism and leaving as a spread of coloured timelines.

name: The Five Laws of Creation (and the earlier Four Laws)
session_title_and_date: 'Creating Your Reality: The Four Laws' — May 2, 1998; 'The 4 Laws of Creation' — May 26, 2012, Silverado CA; 'The 5th Law' — June 7, 2013, San Francisco CA; guide page on bashar.org
concept_summary: Bashar's irreducible 'empirical truths' of existence, which he says are not opinions but the structure everything else follows from. Law one: you exist — and existence cannot become non-existence, so you always will. Law two: everything is here and now — there is only one moment and one place, seen from different points of view. Law three: the One is the All and the All are the One — everything is one thing, differentiated. Law four: what you put out is what you get back — the resonance/reflection principle behind attraction. Law five: everything changes except the first four laws. Historically Bashar taught four laws (existence, oneness, reflection, change), and in 2013 invited exploration of a fifth; the 'here and now' law was inserted as law two in the current five-law form on bashar.org. The laws are the '5' in the 1-3-5-7-11 shorthand.

name: The Seven (Sequential) Steps of Manifestation
session_title_and_date: Guide page on bashar.org (taught in many sessions)
concept_summary: A seven-stage ladder for bringing a desire into experience, each step depending on the one before. Vision: visualise what you want. Desire: be intensely excited about it. Belief: believe it is possible. Acceptance: accept that belief and your ability to manifest it as true for you. Intent: 'want and intend are different' — you must intend it. Action: act and behave as if it has already manifested. Allowance: detach from the outcome — 'be intense in your desire without any expectation that it manifests'. The last step is the one people most often skip, and it is the same 'no insistence' principle found in the excitement formula; belief and acceptance are where core-belief work comes in.
visual_structure: bashar.org page: numbered header-and-description list. Faithful redraw: a seven-rung ladder or staircase read bottom-to-top (Vision at the base, Allowance at the top), or a seven-step arrow.

session_title_and_date: The Interstellar Enneagram 2014; The Five Hybrid Races — April 28, 2018; Sedona Vortex Array 2015

Earth is becoming the 6th hybrid race ('Homo galacticus / luminoso'), and in roughly a thousand years all six blend into a 7th race uniquely connected to space-time itself. The Anunnaki, Orion and Pleiadian lines are the older human 'protosapien/hypersapien' ancestry, not hybrids of this programme.

name: The Prime Radiant (one particle drawing all of reality)
session_title_and_date: Recurring model (e.g. 'The Structure of Existence' December 30, 2017; earlier sessions)

Because it moves infinitely fast it is effectively everywhere at once; where its path intersects itself densely, we perceive solid form — atoms, bodies, planets. The intersections are 'space/time' (structure, matter, the lines of sacred geometry); the gaps between them are 'time/space' (pure energy, potential). Every thought is a flicker of the same particle, so 'even the tiniest electrical surge of thought in your brain affects the entire structure of the universe' — you are not separate from the pattern, you are it. Bashar uses it to explain why sacred-geometry lines matter and why reality responds to state of being.
